summary: Iter245 PO Request consolidation — backend & frontend testing PASSED. Verified /api/vendors retired (404), /api/suppliers serves 146+ items publicly, /api/jobs serves 28 active jobs, supplier inline-add + case-insensitive dedupe work, full PO submit persists vendor (normalized) + project_number. Frontend at 390px: 'Request PO' button + dialog title, JobPicker has no 'Custom Job' option and shows 'contact PM' hint, SupplierCombo loads 146 real vendors (A&L Remediation Services first), inline-add toast 'Added X to vendor list' works, lowercase variant auto-selects existing (Add button hidden — no ugly error), full E2E submission shows 'PO requested' toast and closes dialog, validation toast 'Please select a job…' fires on empty submit. ONE regression: test_iter153_po_requests.py::test_leadership_only_sees_own_pos fails (18/19) — appears pre-existing unrelated to iter245.

minor.issue: test_leadership_only_sees_own_pos asserts requested_by role='leadership' but received 'admin' — looks like a test isolation/seed issue where prior admin-token submissions pollute leadership-scoped list. Iter245 problem statement claimed 19/19 pass; observed 18/19. Likely pre-existing, but flagged.

issues: Radix a11y warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for {DialogContent} — add <DialogDescription> for screen readers (non-blocking).

action_items: Investigate test_iter153_po_requests.py::test_leadership_only_sees_own_pos regression — verify if it's a test data pollution issue or actual role-stamping bug on PO create when X-Leadership-Token is presented alongside admin token.
(Optional polish) Add DialogDescription to the Request PO dialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: AddDialog correctly strips local-only project_name before POST (line ~350) — clean separation between picker UX and PoRequestCreate schema.

SupplierCombo dedupe UX: when user types a case-different variant of an existing vendor, the '+ Add' button is hidden because exactMatch is case-insensitive — this auto-routes the user to select the existing entry. Backend dedupe is also tested. Combined behavior satisfies 'no ugly error' requirement.
JobPicker with allowCustom=false properly hides the Custom Job CommandGroup and shows the configurable emptyHint via CommandEmpty.
vendors_master.py was deleted and /api/vendors returns 404 as expected — consolidation complete; SupplierCombo is now the single source platform-wide.
test_credentials: Field Leadership /leadership password = MASCIGC (used for both UI flow and backend pytest fixture).
seed_data_creation: Backend test creates one supplier 'TEST_Iter245_Vendor_<uuid>' via /api/suppliers/add and one PO via /api/po-requests. UI test creates 'Iter245 UI Test Vendor LLC' and one PO. These remain in the shared collections but are clearly TEST_/Iter245-prefixed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter245 consolidated /api/vendors into /api/suppliers. To extend regression: also run /api/suppliers/add through Daily Reports, Incidents, and QA/QC SupplierCombo entry points to confirm cross-workflow propagation. The iter153 leadership-scope test failure may need a fresh DB run or fixture-level token isolation before reasserting 19/19 in PRD.
rca of the issue: iter153 test_leadership_only_sees_own_pos: when leadership token submits a PO, the persisted requested_by_role is recorded as 'admin' instead of 'leadership'. Likely cause is role resolution in po_requests.py preferring an upstream is_admin flag when both tokens (or seeded admin context) are present. Not introduced by iter245 changes (iter245 only altered the PoRequests frontend AddDialog and removed vendors_master.py); backend role-stamping logic is untouched per the iter245 PRD.
